notes.content:

notes.title: This game has been updated to version 1.40.
notes.content:
This game has been updated to version 1.40.
Added "Level 17 Ambush" and "STEAM Achievement".
You need a graphics board on your computer to play level 17.
You can play the previous version by right-clicking the game name from the STEAM application and clicking "Properties" "Beta".

notes.title: The game has been updated.
notes.content:
The game has been updated.
Added graphic settings to option.
If the sensitivity of the mouse is strange, try changing the setting.
Checked the enemy AI again.
Added "Impossible Mission"(Level16) and "STEAM acheivement".

notes.title: Added trailer level for next game "Gunship Recon".
notes.content:
Added trailer level for next game "Gunship Recon".
And added STEAM achievement.
It is a simple control helicopter arcade game.
This level is a trailer.Ground damage has been disabled.
I use this game's AH-64 instead of AH-6.
The radar function is omitted.
The level 6 mission completion screen has been replaced.
Added wallpaper to the soundtrack.

notes.title: Added a level "Night storm"
notes.content:
Added post-war "Night Storm" level (Level 14) and "STEAM Achievement".
Supported Portuguese, French, Italian, Czech, Korean, Dutch, Traditional Chinese, Finnish, Danish, Norwegian.

notes.title: Extra level added.
notes.content:
Added extra level "Ground attack", you get on the fighter like A-10. 
"STEAM Achievement" of "Ground attack" was added.
The extra levels have been combined into one "Side Story".
I adjusted the game balance of level boarding a helicopter and added STEAM Achievement.
I modified the code to improve the game's operating speed.
If I add extra levels in the future, it will take the form of a free update, not a paid DLC.

notes.title: Extra level "The pilot"
notes.content:
Added short level that you get on the regular fighter. STEAM Achievement is "Willsword Air force Campaign medal".
This game is a finished version, but may have levels added for the benefit of the player.If you don't need any updates, turn off "Update automatically" for this game.
Thank you.

notes.title: Fixed STEAM achievement.
notes.content: Fixed a bug related to the STEAM achievement.
